description:
Stamp a version/edition banner into the website header of `service` (e.g. label='Odoo 19
    Enterprise') so anyone opening the site sees which version it is - via a website.layout-inherit
    QWeb view + the site/company name (also the browser-tab title). Requires the `website` module
    installed (docker_db_init). dry_run shows the script.
name: docker_website_header
